input.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 20128,20129,3000,8080 } | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize; Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'omni|route' } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime | Format-Table -AutoSize
input.description: Look for an OmniRoute listener or process
